questions.question: American college football officials announced that the national championship playoff will expand to how many teams by 2027?
questions.explanation: The College Football Playoff confirmed a format shift from 12 competing teams up to 24 beginning with the 2027 campaign.
questions.context: In college football, the College Football Playoff announces it will expand from 12 to 24 teams starting in the 2027 season.

questions.question: Which television personality and author lost a legal effort to block news outlets from naming him in relation to grooming claims?
questions.explanation: David Walliams was unsuccessful in his court bid to stop media organisations from publishing his name in reports about grooming accusations.
questions.context: David Walliams loses a legal bid to prevent him being named by The Guardian and ITN as a celebrity accused of grooming by several women. Walliams denies the allegations.

questions.question: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka announced plans to step down from office in which country following a dispute over his high-school diploma?
questions.explanation: The Indonesian vice president stated his intention to resign amid lingering arguments concerning whether his secondary school certificate was genuine.
questions.context: Gibran Rakabuming Raka diploma controversy: Indonesian vice president Gibran Rakabuming Raka announces his intention to resign following controversies about the authenticity of his high-school diploma.

questions.story: Russo-Ukrainian war > Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, United Arab Emirates in the 2026 Iran war, United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war > 2026 United States–Ukraine–Russia meetings in Abu Dhabi
questions.question: Which country hosted the third round of peace discussions between delegates from Russia and Ukraine mediated by the United States?
questions.explanation: Diplomatic representatives from the warring nations gathered in Abu Dhabi for talks focused on humanitarian concerns and security arrangements.
questions.context: Russo-Ukrainian war > Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, United Arab Emirates in the 2026 Iran war, United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war > 2026 United States–Ukraine–Russia meetings in Abu Dhabi: A third round of United States-mediated talks between Ukrainian and Russian delegations begins in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, focusing on the humanitarian impact of the war, prisoners of war, and security guarantees. Earlier in the day, the American and Ukrainian teams held a separate meeting with representatives of France, Germany, Italy, the United Kingdom, the European Commission, and NATO.

questions.question: The US Food and Drug Administration instructed makers of GLP-1 weight-loss and diabetes treatments to include warnings about what potential health risk?
questions.explanation: Regulators ordered warning labels regarding an optic nerve condition known to trigger irreversible loss of vision.
questions.context: The United States Food and Drug Administration orders manufacturers of GLP-1 medicines such as semaglutide and tirzepatide, originally intended for the treatment of type 2 diabetes but also commonly used for weight loss, to add warnings that use of such drugs may increase the risk of developing non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, an optic nerve disorder that can cause permanent blindness.
